content: Aaradhya Verma contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor to check the status of her policy renewal. Neha confirmed the renewal was processed on her end, but noted the system incorrectly shows it as expired. She has escalated the issue to the admin team and agreed to follow up to expedite the fix and prevent coverage gaps.

action_items: Escalate issue to admin team to resolve expired status display
Follow up with admin team to expedite the process
Keep customer updated on the status
